quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangsu Novoray New Material results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (06-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Pricing and demand (results briefing): chairman and general manager Li Xiaodong said the company has raised prices on some products; board secretary and CFO Bai Lin said the adjustments followed higher energy and other production-factor costs and changes in exchange rates and export tax-rebate policy amid international changes. The chairman said the value increase downstream mainly reflects a unit-price jump from product-mix upgrades rather than simple price rises. He said the expansion projects are being pushed at full pace, and that as high-speed substrates move to lower-loss M8, M9 and M10 grades and their fillers shift from angular to spherical silica, the company works closely with leading customers and the order trend for these products is relatively optimistic.
